verdict.rationale: Firebase ships the Local Emulator Suite for building and testing apps locally. It covers Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, Authentication, Hosting, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions, and apps connect to it directly for integration testing without touching production data. The CLI also runs a local Hosting server, and a Test SDK supports loading Security Rules and flushing the local database. missing for 10: Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulators are only beta, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of a full local stack working end-to-end.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the whole backend stack locally with an emulator or CLI before deploying

citations.quote: The Firebase Local Emulator Suite is a set of advanced tools for developers looking to build and test apps locally using Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage for Firebase, Authentication, Firebase Hosting, Cloud Functions (beta), Pub/Sub (beta), and Firebase Extensions (beta).
you can connect your app directly to these emulators to perform integration testing or QA without touching production data
you can install and manage Firebase Extensions in a safe local environment and better understand their capabilities while minimizing billing costs
The Test SDK provides several convenience methods for loading Security Rules, flushing the local database between tests
Run a local web server for your Firebase Hosting site
